papers.title: MX-Like Tensor Core for LLM Inference with NPU Integration via Hardware-Software Co-Design Exploration
papers.abstract: Block-scaled quantization formats such as OCP Microscaling (MX) and NVFP4 have been widely adopted as efficient data formats for LLM inference. However, the design space of these formats spanned by shared scale, weight, and activation format combinations has not been systematically explored, and the joint accuracy-silicon tradeoff across this space remains uncharacterized, leaving the true Pareto-optimal configurations for NPU-based edge LLM deployment an open question. To bridge this gap, we conduct a joint hardware-software (HW-SW) co-design exploration of the above underexplored MX-like design space with three innovations. 1) We define and systematically characterize the full 8-bit scale format family within the MX-like design space, jointly with asymmetric weight-activation precision, identifying configurations that outperform the MX and NVFP4-like (without per-tensor scaling, PTS) baselines. 2) We build a per-format specialized MAC datapath template that enables fair hardware cost evaluation across the space. 3) We develop an automated co-design flow, integrated into the open-source SNAX NPU platform, that enables joint HW-SW analysis across the design space. Overall, our co-design exploration reveals that scale format matters only under aggressive FP4 quantization, yielding a case-oriented design guideline for both scale format and asymmetric weight-activation precision. We further identify UE5M3 as a favorable accuracy-hardware tradeoff for the FP4 regime, reducing perplexity degradation by up to 25.3% relative to the NVFP4-like baseline, at a cost of only +0.06% area and +0.49% power overhead.

papers.title_zh: 面向 LLM 推理的类 MX 张量核心：通过软硬件协同设计探索实现 NPU 集成
papers.summary_cn: 本文针对 OCP Microscaling（MX）、NVFP4 等块缩放量化格式，系统刻画了由共享缩放因子、权重格式与激活格式组合构成的类 MX 设计空间；此前该空间中精度与硅成本的联合权衡尚未被量化，NPU 边缘端 LLM 部署的帕累托最优配置仍是开放问题。作者定义了完整的 8 位缩放格式族，并将其与非对称权重—激活精度联合分析，同时为每种格式构建专用的 MAC 数据通路模板，以支撑公平的硬件代价评估。作者将上述分析集成为自动化协同设计流程，嵌入开源 SNAX NPU 平台，实现跨设计空间的软硬件联合评估。结果显示，缩放格式只在激进 FP4 量化下才显著影响精度，并据此给出面向场景的设计准则；其中 UE5M3 配置相较 NVFP4-like 基线将困惑度退化最多降低 25.3%，仅付出 +0.06% 面积与 +0.49% 功耗开销。
innovations: 定义并系统刻画了类 MX 设计空间中完整的 8 位缩放格式族，并与非对称权重—激活精度联合搜索，找出优于 MX 与 NVFP4-like（不使用 per-tensor scaling, PTS）基线的配置
为每种格式构建专用 MAC 数据通路模板（per-format specialized MAC datapath template），使整个设计空间内的硬件成本可在同一口径下公平比较，而非沿用某一格式的通用估算
在开源 SNAX NPU 平台上实现自动化软硬件协同设计流程，可对格式、精度与硬件代价做联合分析，并给出面向场景的缩放格式与非对称精度选择准则
识别出 UE5M3 是 FP4 区间精度—硬件折衷较优的配置：困惑度退化相对 NVFP4-like 基线最多降低 25.3%，面积仅 +0.06%、功耗仅 +0.49%；并发现缩放格式的作用只在激进 FP4 量化下才显现
papers.scenario_cn: 面向边缘侧 NPU 上部署 LLM 的量化格式与张量核心选型：当需要在 FP4 级低比特推理中兼顾精度与面积/功耗预算时，可直接依据本文的准则挑选缩放格式与非对称权重—激活精度组合，并用于 NPU 张量核心的早期架构探索。

papers.title: Unbounded Losses, Unchecked Inputs: Measuring the Safeguards of LLM Options-Trading Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents now place options orders at retail brokers, and developers publish open-source options agents faster than anyone has examined them. Prior security work on trading agents scored academic equities designs by whether an attacker can flip a buy-or-sell decision. We present the first measurement of the options agents that brokers and developers ship, scored by the safeguards they enforce and by the worst loss their documented order paths can reach. We screened 765 GitHub repositories, broker documentation, and the research literature and found 215 eligible repositories and 8 broker-native agent interfaces. We then scored 26 systems, including every broker interface and every open-source project with at least 20 stars, on seven robustness and eleven security safeguards with cell-level evidence. The ecosystem is new: 198 of the 215 repositories were created in 2026, and 129 (60.0%) appeared in the two weeks around one options-trading hackathon. Of the 22 systems that can place orders, 10 enforce a pre-trade limit outside the model, yet none of the 26 authenticate their text sources or cross-check market data. Of the 26, 17 can execute with no mandatory human step and 13 can reach unbounded loss, including 6 of the 8 broker interfaces. Because an attacker who writes the agent's inputs can move an order's strike, expiry, volatility, and legs while its direction stays correct, options agents need loss limits enforced at the order boundary.

papers.title_zh: 无界亏损、未检输入：LLM 期权交易智能体安全防护的测量研究
papers.summary_cn: 论文指出现有交易智能体安全研究只针对学术界的股票设计、以“攻击者能否翻转买/卖方向”为评分标准，而真实券商与开发者已在零售端上线期权交易智能体，因此首次对已交付的期权智能体做系统性测量：以“实际执行的防护措施”和“文档化下单路径可能达到的最坏亏损”为评分维度。作者筛查 765 个 GitHub 仓库、券商文档与研究文献，得到 215 个合格仓库和 8 个券商原生智能体接口，并对 26 个系统（覆盖全部券商接口以及所有 20 star 以上的开源项目）按 7 项鲁棒性与 11 项安全防护逐项给出单元格级证据打分。结果显示生态极新：215 个仓库中 198 个创建于 2026 年，129 个（60.0%）集中出现在某次期权交易黑客松前后两周；22 个可下单系统中仅 10 个在模型之外实施事前交易限额，26 个系统无一验证文本来源或交叉核对行情数据，17 个无需人工确认即可执行，13 个可触及无界亏损（含 8 个券商接口中的 6 个）。作者据此论证：攻击者只要控制智能体输入，就能在保持方向正确的前提下改动行权价、到期日、波动率与腿数，因此损失限额必须强制施加在下单边界上。
innovations: 首次把测量对象从学术股票交易智能体转向已上线的期权交易智能体，并以“最坏可达亏损”而非“买/卖方向是否被翻转”作为安全评分维度，揭示方向正确但参数被篡改的隐蔽攻击面。
构建并公开了一套细粒度评分体系：7 项鲁棒性 + 11 项安全防护、单元格级证据，对 26 个系统（含 8 个券商原生接口与全部 20 star 以上开源项目）完成打分，样本来自 765 个仓库筛查后的 215 个合格仓库。
给出生态画像的量化发现：198/215 仓库创建于 2026 年、129 个（60.0%）聚集在一次黑客松前后两周，说明该领域安全审查严重滞后于开源供给。
定位出关键缺口：26 个系统均未验证文本来源或交叉核对行情数据，22 个可下单系统中仅 10 个在模型外设事前限额，13 个可触及无界亏损（含 6/8 券商接口），据此提出在订单边界强制损失限额的防护主张。
papers.scenario_cn: 面向零售券商、量化交易平台与开源期权智能体开发者的上线前安全评估与合规审查，用于判断一个能自主下单的 LLM 交易智能体在提示注入、行情数据被污染时是否会造成不可控资金损失；也适用于交易系统的风控网关与下单前置校验设计。

papers.title: Finite BSC-Decomposition of Binary-Input Symmetric-Output Channels and Applications to Channel Simulation
papers.abstract: We propose a finite BSC-decomposition method for representing an arbitrary binary-input symmetric-output channel (BISOC) as a mixture of binary symmetric channels (BSCs) with at most $\ell+1$ distinct crossover probabilities. We show that the weighted average capacity of the component BSCs exceeds the capacity of the original BISOC by at most $(\pi^2\log e)/(48\ell^2)+O(\ell^{-5/2})$ bits, and the leading term is asymptotically optimal in the worst case. Based on the finite BSC-decomposition, we design a channel simulation scheme for arbitrary BISOCs. Combined with efficient channel simulation algorithms for BSCs, our scheme achieves a communication rate with $O((\log n / n)^{2/3})$ redundancy over the capacity for simulating $n$ copies of a BISOC.

papers.title_zh: 二输入对称输出信道的有限BSC分解及其在信道模拟中的应用
papers.summary_cn: 论文研究如何把任意二输入对称输出信道（BISOC）精确地表示成二元对称信道（BSC）的有限混合，提出「有限BSC分解」：用至多 ℓ+1 个交叉概率互不相同的 BSC 做加权混合来逼近原信道。理论分析证明，这些分量 BSC 的加权平均容量比原 BISOC 容量最多只少 (π² log e)/(48ℓ²)+O(ℓ^{-5/2}) 比特，且该主项在最坏情况下是渐近最优的，说明分解带来的容量损失已被压到极限。基于这一分解，作者设计了面向任意 BISOC 的信道模拟方案，复用已有的高效 BSC 模拟算法，在模拟 n 个 BISOC 副本时把相对容量的冗余降到 O((log n / n)^{2/3})。
innovations: 提出有限 BSC 分解：证明任意 BISOC 可写成至多 ℓ+1 个交叉概率互异的 BSC 的凸混合，把连续/一般信道结构约化为少量参数化基信道
给出容量损失上界 (π² log e)/(48ℓ²)+O(ℓ^{-5/2}) 比特，并证明其首项在最坏情况下渐近最优，界是紧的
将分解与高效 BSC 模拟算法组合，构造出对任意 BISOC 的模拟方案，n 次副本的容量冗余为 O((log n / n)^{2/3})
把一般信道模拟问题归约到 BSC 这一易处理的特例，使分解后的模拟复杂度只依赖 ℓ 而非信道输出字母表大小
papers.scenario_cn: 适用于需要在发送端与接收端之间以接近容量的速率「人造生成」任意二输入对称输出信道样本的场合，例如物理层保密通信中的信道模拟、信道编码与信息论极限的仿真验证，以及需要低成本精确复现特定信道行为的系统测试。

papers.title: Beyond the Teacher: Understanding and Preserving Distillation Overshoot in Agentic On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains agents on their own trajectories using supervision from a stronger teacher. We uncover a counterintuitive phenomenon in multi-turn agentic tasks: a smaller, initially weaker student can substantially outperform its teacher during training, only to regress as distillation continues. We term this phenomenon distillation overshoot. Through decision- and task-level analyses, we trace overshoot to two competing effects of OPD: repairing weak student decisions and eroding successful student choices that the teacher disfavors. Early in training, repair outpaces erosion, allowing the student to combine the teacher's corrections with its own strengths and surpass the teacher. As training continues, erosion overtakes repair, causing these gains to vanish. Motivated by this finding, we propose Success-Preserving On-Policy Distillation (SPOD), which selectively masks conflicting teacher supervision on successful student choices and introduces a soft probability floor to counteract their erosion, while retaining teacher guidance elsewhere. SPOD requires only binary episode success and model probabilities already available during OPD. Across two model families and three agentic benchmarks, SPOD consistently outperforms ordinary OPD and evaluated variants, improving final success by up to 15.2 percentage points and surpassing the teacher by up to 20.0 points. Moreover, SPOD's final checkpoints outperform even ordinary OPD's best intermediate checkpoints in all six settings, demonstrating that beyond-teacher gains can be not only preserved but further extended. papers.title_zh: 超越教师：理解并保留智能体在线策略蒸馏中的蒸馏过冲现象
papers.summary_cn: 本文研究多轮智能体任务中的在线策略蒸馏（On-Policy Distillation, OPD），即让学生模型在自己的轨迹上接受更强教师的监督，并发现一个反直觉现象：更小的学生模型在训练中期可显著超过教师，但继续蒸馏后性能反而回落，作者将其命名为 distillation overshoot（蒸馏过冲）。通过在决策级与任务级做分析，作者把过冲归因于 OPD 中两种相互竞争的作用——修复学生的弱决策，以及侵蚀教师不认可但学生原本正确的成功选择：训练早期修复快于侵蚀，学生得以融合教师纠正与自身优势而超越教师，后期侵蚀占上风使增益消失。基于此提出 Success-Preserving On-Policy Distillation（SPOD），对学生在成功选择上与教师冲突的监督做选择性屏蔽，并引入软概率下限以抵抗侵蚀，其余位置仍保留教师指导，且仅需回合级的二元成功信号与 OPD 中已有的模型概率。在两个模型族、三个智能体基准上，SPOD 稳定优于普通 OPD 及所评估的变体，最终成功率最高提升 15.2 个百分点，超越教师最多 20.0 点，且六个设置中 SPOD 的最终 checkpoint 均优于普通 OPD 最好的中间 checkpoint。
innovations: 发现并命名了多轮智能体任务中的 distillation overshoot 现象：更弱的学生在 OPD 中期可超过教师，随后因持续蒸馏而回退
将过冲机制拆解为 repair（修复学生弱决策）与 erosion（侵蚀教师不认可的成功学生选择）两种竞争效应，并用决策级、任务级分析给出二者的时序交叉解释
提出 SPOD 方法：对成功学生选择上相互冲突的教师监督做选择性掩码，并加入软概率下限（soft probability floor）抵消侵蚀，在冲突区域外保留教师信号
SPOD 只需回合级二元成功标签和 OPD 已有的模型概率，无需额外奖励模型；在两个模型族、三个基准、六个设置中最终成功率最高 +15.2 个百分点、超越教师最多 +20.0 点，且最终 checkpoint 全面优于普通 OPD 的最佳中间 checkpoint
papers.scenario_cn: 适用于用强教师模型蒸馏多轮智能体（工具调用、环境交互类任务）的训练流程：可避免学生被教师过度同化而丢掉自身已有的正确行为，尤其适合成功信号只有回合级成/败、没有细粒度偏好标注的工程场景。

papers.title: Distillation, Self-Training, and the Fragility of Learned Chemical Reasoning
papers.abstract: Automating synthesis planning for small-molecule drug design requires chemical reasoners that are accurate as well as open to inspection and adaptation, yet frontier language models remain unreliable at predicting reaction outcomes and difficult to deploy, while small open-weight models lack the necessary domain reasoning. We show that frontier supervision can serve as a one-time bootstrap for open models on forward reaction prediction. Our models, Resonance, distill an open-weight teacher's reasoning traces and then learn from their own verified outputs, turning a small base model with near-zero accuracy into a capable reaction predictor, while a stronger student surpasses its teacher through distillation alone. Accuracy, however, does not bring robust reasoning: the small student inherits its teacher's single-pass style, self-training mainly sharpens answers it could already reach, and it readily abandons correct answers under pushback, suggesting that chemical reasoning models should be evaluated on the robustness of their reasoning as well as on the accuracy of their answers.

papers.title_zh: 蒸馏、自训练与习得化学推理的脆弱性
papers.summary_cn: 论文研究开源小模型能否借前沿模型监督获得可靠的正向反应预测能力，并训练出 Resonance 系列化学推理模型：以 Kimi K3 为教师提供推理轨迹做监督微调（S1），再让学生在自己经校验的输出上自训练（S2、S3）。在 USPTO-50k 的 5000 条测试反应上，Qwen3-8B 学生从近乎零准确率提升到 S1 29.0%、S2 38.8%、S3 41.3% 的 Top-1，更强的 27B 学生仅靠蒸馏即超过教师。但准确率并未带来稳健推理：学生继承教师的单遍推理风格，加长推理与增加回溯并不提升准确率，且在无信息含量的“反驳”反馈下会放弃原本正确的答案（S1 掉 3.2–3.7 分、S3 掉 8.7–9.2 分），作者据此主张化学推理模型需同时评估推理稳健性。
innovations: 提出 Resonance 模型族与三阶段训练流水线（Kimi K3 轨迹蒸馏 SFT → 基于自验证输出的自训练），把 Qwen3-8B 从近零准确率提升到 USPTO-50k 上 41.3% Top-1，并证明 27B 学生可仅靠蒸馏超越教师。
逐阶段拆解性能来源并配合显著性分析，发现起点更强的 27B 基座所需流水线更短（S2 需重平衡），说明收益主要来自教师引导 SFT 而非重复自训练。
设计“pushback”鲁棒性探针：把模型自己的答案连同无信息反馈回灌，错误负反馈在 S1 造成 3.2–3.7 分、S3 造成 8.7–9.2 分准确率下降，而“被告知正确”仅带来不足 1 分提升，证明答案是随反馈而非随证据改变。

papers.title: EmbodiedWorld-200K: Toward Embodied World Agents via Embodied-Planning Dataset and Interactive World Models
papers.abstract: Building embodied agents that can perceive, reason, and act across diverse 3D worlds is a central research direction toward artificial general intelligence. Yet most existing work remains confined to specific tasks in a single scene and transfers poorly to new environments, leaving general embodied agents for open-world settings under-explored. We refer to such agents as Embodied World Agents (EWAs), whose defining property is the ability to understand diverse visual environments and execute general actions in open-world conditions. To advance EWA research, we study open-world embodied navigation-planning and release EmbodiedWorld-200K, a large-scale dataset of over 200K samples spanning diverse scenes. Each example is equipped with multi-level annotations, ranging from low-level camera-motion trajectories to high-level semantic instructions. The dataset also provides unified evaluation splits and task-specific metrics, supporting offline pretraining and fair evaluation of EWAs. Beyond offline supervision, a defining characteristic of an EWA is its interaction with the environment; training solely on offline data is therefore insufficient, especially for generalizing to scenes not covered in the training distribution. Building dedicated real interactive environments, however, is often prohibitively expensive. To address this, we propose a novel training scheme that employs a video world model as a low-cost environment proxy and performs interactive reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training of the EWA within it. Empirically, pretraining on EmbodiedWorld-200K substantially improves the open-world embodied planning ability of the EWA, and further RL post-training inside a world model yields clear gains on out-of-distribution scenes. The dataset, baseline checkpoints, and training and evaluation code are available at this https URL .

papers.title: MEMORA: A Memory-Enhanced Multimodal Committee Reranking Agent for Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval
papers.abstract: Reasoning-intensive retrieval is fundamentally challenged when queries demand deep semantic inference and arrive in multimodal form. Existing systems treat each query in isolation, rely on monolithic rerankers, and lack retrievers trained for cross-modal reasoning. We introduce MEMORA, a Memory-Enhanced Multimodal Orchestrated Reranking Agent built around three contributions: (1) Collaborative Factor-Committee Reranking, which decomposes queries into intent factors, extracts factor-specific evidence into a structured matrix, and synthesizes judgments via a memory-conditioned meta-verdict model; (2) an Episodic Memory Module that tracks factor outcomes across queries and dynamically adjusts priorities at inference time; and (3) a Reasoning-Aware Dense Retriever fine-tuned with chain-of-thought augmentation on 20k+ reasoning-intensive pairs. Evaluated on MM-BRIGHT across 29 domains, MEMORA achieves nDCG@10 of 41.5 (text-to-text) and 38.9 (multimodal query-to-text), outperforming the strongest agentic text-only baseline by +8.3 points and the strongest agentic multimodal baseline by +7.9 points. Code and data are available at this https URL .

papers.title: CAT-RAG: Improving Secure Code Generation with Category-Aware Agentic Retrieval
papers.abstract: Despite rapid progress in LLM-based code generation, security vulnerabilities remain widespread, and retrieval-augmented code generation (RACG) can further amplify risk when retrieved knowledge is verbose or vulnerable to poisoning. Existing secure RACG approaches inject security knowledge at a fine-grained vulnerability level, causing prompt overhead and diluted model attention when a query implicates multiple related weaknesses. We propose CAT-RAG, an agentic security category-aware retrieval-augmented code generation framework. CAT-RAG performs adaptive category selection via an LLM as a categorizer agent and operates either as a standalone security layer or as a drop-in add-on to RACG pipelines, requiring no modification to the underlying model. We replace CWE-level retrieval with compact, language-specific security categories. These categories provide a higher-level abstraction over individual CWE weaknesses, organizing them by the security concern they share, such as Input Validation and Injection Attacks, rather than merely grouping related entries. Each category consolidates best practices and secure code examples into a single, prompt-efficient representation. We perform a comprehensive evaluation across CyberSecEval, CodeGuard+, and HumanEval. On CyberSecEval, CAT-RAG nearly doubles the secure code generation improvement over the state of the art (23.57% vs. 12.11%) while reducing token overhead by 41.71%.

papers.title: KVCompass: A Discovery Plane for Internet-Scale Prefix Cache Sharing in LLM Serving
papers.abstract: KV cache reuse is one of the most effective ways to reduce LLM inference cost, but today its benefits are largely confined to a single cluster. When a provider serves the same model across geographically distributed regions, each region may repeatedly prefill the same popular prefixes, wasting GPU time and increasing time-to-first-token (TTFT). Exploiting reuse across regions involves discovering which worker currently holds a reusable KV cache for each request's prefix. We show that this KV cache discovery problem is structurally harder than conventional object lookup. Unlike hash-placement mechanisms such as DHTs, where an object's location is a deterministic function of its key, KV caches are created on the workers that serve requests, and their holder sets change with subsequent requests and KV cache evictions. KV cache discovery therefore calls for decoupling KV cache identity from placement. We present KVCompass, a discovery plane for Internet-scale KV cache sharing. The discovery index supports variable-length prefix lookup with constant-time local table reads at the edge, allowing each request to be forwarded to the worker that best balances KV cache reuse against load and network distance. Evaluation includes a 64-worker geo-distributed simulation and a 14-worker three-continent real-machine testbed. Evaluation shows that KVCompass achieves $1.3-14\times$ lower P99 TTFT than the baselines, up to $3.7\times$ lower P99 end-to-end latency, up to $4.7\times$ the throughput, and a peak load factor within 2% of the Oracle floor.

papers.title_zh: KVCompass：面向互联网规模 LLM 服务前缀缓存共享的发现平面
papers.summary_cn: 论文研究的是跨地域多区域部署同一模型时的 KV 缓存复用问题：当单个服务商在多个地理位置分发同一模型时，各区域会重复 prefill 相同热门前缀，浪费 GPU 算力并拉高首 token 延迟（TTFT）；而跨区复用的前提是发现某个请求的前缀当前由哪个 worker 持有可复用的 KV 缓存。作者指出该“KV 缓存发现”问题在结构上比传统对象查找更难：DHT 等哈希放置机制中对象位置是键的确定函数，而 KV 缓存是在服务请求的 worker 上被动产生的，其持有者集合会随后续请求和缓存驱逐不断变化，因此必须把 KV 缓存身份与放置位置解耦。为此提出 KVCompass 发现平面，其发现索引支持变长前缀查找，并能在边缘侧以常数时间完成本地表读取，从而把请求转发到在 KV 复用、负载与网络距离之间综合最优的 worker。评估覆盖 64 worker 地理分布式仿真与 14 worker 跨三大洲真机测试床，取得比基线低 1.3–14 倍的 P99 TTFT、最高 3.7 倍更低的 P99 端到端延迟、最高 4.7 倍的吞吐，峰值负载因子与 Oracle 下界相差不超过 2%。
innovations: 将跨区域 KV 缓存复用中的“缓存发现”形式化为独立问题，并论证其与 DHT 式哈希放置的本质差异：KV 缓存由服务请求的 worker 动态生成、持有者集合随请求与驱逐变化，因而不能把位置当作键的确定函数，提出将缓存身份与放置位置解耦的设计原则。
设计可变长前缀的发现索引，支持边缘侧常数时间的本地表读取，使请求路由能够同时权衡 KV 缓存复用收益、worker 负载和网络距离，而不是只做最近邻或近似哈希查找。
构建 KVCompass 作为互联网规模 KV 缓存共享的发现平面，并在 64 worker 地理分布式仿真与 14 worker 跨三大洲真机测试床上验证，覆盖仿真与真实广域网络两种条件。

papers.title: ATEST: Adaptive Resource-Aware Test-Time Scaling for LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language model (LLM) reasoning by sampling multiple answers, but fixed sampling budgets ignore both query difficulty and the changing energy cost of inference under GPU contention. We measure up to a 4.1-fold increase in energy for the same four-sample query as GPU load rises. We present ATEST, a resource-aware TTS framework that jointly considers the expected value of additional samples and their current GPU cost. ATEST-Online, its default mode, requires no offline calibration: it incrementally generates samples, estimates the stability of the plurality answer, monitors live GPU conditions, and learns step energy cost online to decide when to stop. ATEST-Calibrated instead selects a per-query budget using offline accuracy and cost models, favoring deployments with stable loads. We evaluate both modes on four reasoning and question-answering datasets using Phi-3-mini on an NVIDIA A100 under controlled varying load, and test transfer to an NVIDIA L40S and Qwen2.5-3B. Across the four A100 datasets, ATEST-Online answers every query without exceeding the energy budget, while achieving the highest or statistically tied accuracy and reducing sampling as load increases. On GSM8K at high load, it achieves 60.0% accuracy with no deferrals, versus 44.0% accuracy and 42.4% deferrals for ATEST-Calibrated. Ablations show that online cost learning drives adaptation to load. Including offline profiling, ATEST-Online uses 42 times less GPU time and 48 times less energy than ATEST-Calibrated for the evaluated workload. Online control trades higher tail latency and lower throughput on short tasks for robustness under varying load; offline calibration remains competitive under stable conditions.

papers.title: Hierarchical and Query-Aware Visual Token Pruning for High-Resolution LVLMs
papers.abstract: High-resolution Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) preserve critical, fine-grained visual details by encoding a global thumbnail alongside multiple local crops. However, the resulting thousands of vision tokens introduce severe computational bottlenecks during Large Language Model (LLM) inference. Existing token pruning methods rely primarily on query-agnostic visual saliency, while current query-aware approaches either operate at a coarse crop-level resolution or compute token relevance too late, after vision tokens have already entered the heavy LLM layers. To address this, we propose a training-free, hierarchical token pruning framework that utilizes query guidance prior to executing any LLM blocks. Our top-down hierarchy first operates at the instance-level, dynamically scaling the vision token retention ratio of each sample based on its visual complexity. Next, at the crop-level, we distribute this sample budget across local crops using sentence-level cross-modal similarity. Finally, at the token-level, we exploit projected vision tokens alongside textual query token embeddings in the shared space to measure fine-grained alignment, applying a text-debiasing normalization to produce high-fidelity query scores. These query-guided budgets and scores are fused with local and global visual saliency metrics to select the most critical vision tokens. Extensive experiments on LLaVA-NeXT-7B demonstrate that our plug-and-play framework retains 98.0% and 94.8% of unpruned performance at 25% and 10% vision token retention, respectively. Notably, at 25% retention, our method delivers a 2.0x inference throughput speedup and even surpasses the unpruned baseline on POPE by 0.7 points.

papers.title: Koi: Evidence-Guided, Self-Calibrating Planning for Multi-Cloud, Heterogeneous LLM Inference Fleets
papers.abstract: Deploying a large language model (LLM) requires choosing the right accelerator, parallelization strategy, engine configuration, and replica count amongst ~140 other variables across clouds, regions, and markets. These decisions are intertwined, and the best cluster-wide plan continually changes as jobs contend for shared capacity on shifting workloads. We present Koi, a self-calibrating cluster planner for heterogeneous, multi-cloud fleets. Koi uses a Recursive Language Model (RLM) hierarchy to propose hypotheses and reason over deployment while deterministic components predict serving behavior, score candidates, and control placement. It represents inference behavior as a fixed causal graph linking decisions (e.g., accelerator, parallelism), runtime mediators (e.g., KV-cache pressure, communication overhead), and outcomes (e.g., latency, throughput). Each deployment strengthens or weakens scoped causal relationships, building a comprehensive playbook for inference that the planner employs to guide future decisions. Job-wise configurations are composed into cluster-wide plans and evaluated against serving objectives, resource constraints, SLO risks, and cost. Across benchmarks, Koi achieves 1.18x greater goodput than the strongest baseline while reducing $/token by 20% in a real heterogeneous cluster. Ablations isolate the contribution of Koi's architecture: a pure language model attains a composite score of 35.3, the same model equipped with Koi's deterministic tools reaches 51.6, and the full Koi planner reaches 70.8.

构建“决策—运行时中介量—结果”固定因果图来表示推理行为，并用每次部署结果对范围内因果关系做强化或削弱，形成可累积、可复用的推理 playbook。
支持约 140 个跨云、跨区域、跨市场的部署变量联合规划，把单作业配置组合为集群级方案，并同时以服务目标、资源约束、SLO 风险与成本为目标进行评估。
在真实异构多云集群上取得 1.18 倍 goodput 并降低 20% $/token，验证了自校准机制相对静态规划的实际收益。

papers.title: A failure of Imagination: VLMs fail to use visual representations for text, but self-distillation can help
papers.abstract: Vision-language (VL) models are typically built by fine-tuning a language model to attend to visual features in service of a Visual Question-Answering objective. We ask whether this alignment changes how language models represent text---especially on tasks where visualization would help, like geometry questions posed in words. We distinguish weak multimodality (the model can answer questions about an input image) from strong multimodality (the model's text representations themselves become vision-aligned, improving performance on text-only tasks with latent visual structure). To test for strong multimodality, we construct a task of shape-counting problems with paired equivalent text and image specifications. This task is trivial when the image is provided, but requires visualization when specified in text as line coordinates. We compare instruction-tuned Qwen-2.5 and Mistral models against their vision-aligned counterparts on the text variant of the task. We find that the multimodal models do no better in this setting, despite strong performance on the image version of the task. Probing experiments corroborate this: vision-aligned decoder embeddings carry no more visual structure than their text-only counterparts. Finally, we provide an optimization objective that distills in-context visual embeddings into text embeddings. This alignment induces gains on the text variant of the task without explicit task supervision, even on samples more complex than seen during alignment. This suggests that VQA-style alignment leaves available cross-modal transfer untapped.

papers.title_zh: 想象力的缺失：视觉语言模型无法为文本调用视觉表征，但自蒸馏可以改善
papers.summary_cn: 论文区分了“弱多模态”（模型能回答关于输入图像的问题）与“强多模态”（模型自身的文本表征被视觉对齐，从而提升具有潜在视觉结构的纯文本任务），并设计了一个“形状计数”任务：同一道题分别以图像和文本行坐标两种等价形式给出，后者必须靠心象可视化才能解。作者用指令微调的 Qwen-2.5 和 Mistral 与其视觉对齐版本在纯文本变体上对比，发现多模态模型并不比纯文本模型更好，尽管它们在图像版任务上表现很强；探针实验进一步显示视觉对齐后的解码器嵌入并未比纯文本版本携带更多视觉结构。最后作者提出一个把上下文内视觉嵌入蒸馏进文本嵌入的优化目标，在没有显式任务监督的情况下提升了文本变体成绩，甚至泛化到比对齐阶段更复杂的样本。

papers.scenario_cn: 针对纯文本输入却隐含空间/几何结构（如文字描述的几何题、坐标与图表说明）的推理任务，适用于改进视觉语言模型的对齐训练流程，让模型在无障碍获取图像时也能调用视觉表征。

papers.title: ATLAS: Learning to Adapt LVLM Attention for Reasoning Video Segmentation
papers.abstract: Reasoning Video Object Segmentation (RVOS) aims to localize and segment objects referred to by natural-language expressions throughout a video. Although large vision-language models (LVLMs) implicitly encode localization cues in their attention maps, these attentions are often noisy, diffuse, and scattered across layers, heads, and modalities, limiting their direct use for segmentation. Existing methods typically rely on handcrafted attention-selection heuristics or computationally expensive attention refinement. We propose ATLAS, an attention adaptation framework that learns to transform raw LVLM attentions into object-centric localization cues. ATLAS treats attentions from all layers, heads, and modalities as structured features, combining high-resolution frame-level attentions that capture spatial information with low-resolution video-level attentions that encode temporal context. A lightweight U-Net equipped with temporal attention and FiLM-based modulation fuses these complementary representations to generate coarse segmentation heatmaps, which are propagated across the video using SAM2. Extensive experiments on challenging referring and reasoning video segmentation benchmarks show that ATLAS outperforms existing frozen-backbone methods. papers.title: Are We Evaluating VLM Token Pruning Right? Looking Beyond Accuracy and Token Count
papers.abstract: Visual token pruning aims to reduce inference cost while preserving the capabilities of the original VLM. Yet existing evaluations rely on aggregate task accuracy and retained token count as proxies for pruning quality and actual efficiency. We reveal two limitations: 1) Aggregate accuracy can obscure whether a pruning method truly identifies critical visual tokens; many examples remain solvable under arbitrary token removal and models can exploit textual shortcuts when visual evidence is degraded. 2) Retained token count is an unreliable proxy for efficiency, as identical token budgets can incur different end-to-end costs depending on where and how pruning is performed. Consequently, comparisons based on aggregate accuracy and retained token counts fail to recover the global performance-efficiency Pareto frontier across methods. We introduce PAA-Bench, a plug-and-play evaluation framework for existing benchmarks, to evaluate whether pruning succeeds through meaningful token selection and whether this success translates into real speedup. To determine when token choice actually matters, we propose Random-Pass@k to measure how often an example remains correct under random pruning, enabling comprehensive evaluation across different levels of selection difficulty. To compare efficiency fairly, we introduce Preservation-Constrained Speedup (PCS) to report the maximum end-to-end speedup each method achieves under a shared preservation target. Experiments across 8 methods, 3 VLM backbones, and 9 benchmarks show that stronger token compression does not necessarily yield greater speedup, method differences widen on examples where token selection matters, and efficiency rankings change with the preservation target.

papers.title_zh: 我们是否在正确地评估 VLM 视觉 Token 剪枝？超越准确率与 Token 数量的考察
papers.summary_cn: 该论文指出，现有视觉 token 剪枝评估存在两个问题：一是使用整体任务准确率作为代理指标，无法判断剪枝方法是否真正选中了关键视觉 token，因为很多样本随机删掉 token 后仍可答对，模型还会转而利用文本捷径；二是保留的 token 数量不能可靠反映真实效率，因为相同的 token 预算，会因剪枝位置和实现方式不同而导致端到端开销不同。为此，作者提出可即插即用的评估框架 PAA-Bench，并设计 Random-Pass@k 指标来度量样本在随机剪枝下仍保持正确的频率，从而划分出“token 选择是否重要”的难度层级；同时提出 Preservation-Constrained Speedup（PCS），在统一的保真目标下报告各方法可达的最大端到端加速比。在 8 种剪枝方法、3 个 VLM 主干和 9 个基准上的实验表明：更强的 token 压缩并不必然带来更大加速；在 token 选择真正关键的样本上，方法间差距被放大；效率排名也会随保真目标变化。
innovations: 提出 PAA-Bench：一个可直接套用到现有基准上的评估框架，把“剪枝是否通过有意义的 token 选择生效”与“该效果是否转化为真实加速”分开度量。
提出 Random-Pass@k 指标，统计样本在随机剪枝下仍答对的频率，据此识别整体准确率被文本捷径或简单样本掩盖的区域，并按选择难度分层评估。
提出 Preservation-Constrained Speedup (PCS)，在相同保真约束下比较各方法的最大端到端加速，取代以保留 token 数作为效率代理的做法。
在 8 种方法 × 3 个 VLM 主干 × 9 个基准上给出实证结论：压缩率与加速比不单调对应，效率排序随保真目标改变，且基于聚合准确率和 token 数的比较无法恢复方法间的全局性能-效率 Pareto 前沿。
papers.scenario_cn: 适用于多模态大模型推理服务的选型与验收：帮助工程团队判断某个视觉 token 剪枝方案在真实部署中能带来多少端到端延迟收益，以及其加速是否建立在可靠的视觉证据选择之上，从而避免被虚高的准确率或“保留 token 数”指标误导。

papers.title: How Much Can We Prune? Exploring the Performance Limits of Visual Token Pruning
papers.abstract: Visual token pruning is increasingly used to reduce the memory and inference costs of vision-language models. Existing work has largely focused on designing method-specific selectors and demonstrating incremental improvements over prior methods at selected token budgets. It remains unclear whether the resulting performance reflects an inherent limit of visual token pruning or the limitations of current token-selection algorithms. We take a complementary perspective and ask: \emph{how well can visual token pruning perform when offline search cost is not the primary constraint?} We formulate pruning for general image understanding as selecting, under a fixed budget, one shared visual-token subset that supports a broad distribution of questions about an image. We approximate this utility with a finite auxiliary QA set generated by a frontier VLM and optimize a teacher-forced answer-probability objective with the evaluated model frozen. Motivated by the conceptual monotonicity and diminishing returns of adding visual evidence, we construct nested subsets greedily and introduce \emph{QA mini-batch greedy} (QA-MBG), which estimates token marginal gains from randomly sampled QA components at each step. Empirically, QA-MBG is both cheaper and more effective than full greedy. With one frontier-VLM call and approximately $0.5$ H100 GPU-hours per image, it produces a nested subset trajectory covering keep ratios up to $0.3$. Across Qwen3-VL-4B and Gemma~4 E4B on $900$ images from nine benchmarks, we find significant headroom over evaluated pruning baselines on held-out QA and image-grounded long-form generation, while the searched subsets substantially narrow the gap to full-token inference.

papers.title_zh: 我们究竟能剪掉多少？探究视觉 Token 剪枝的性能上限
papers.summary_cn: 论文不设计新的剪枝选择器，而是回答“若离线搜索成本不是主要约束，视觉 token 剪枝能做到多好”这一上限问题：把面向通用图像理解的剪枝形式化为在固定预算下选取一个共享视觉 token 子集，使其支撑关于该图像的广泛问题分布。作者用前沿 VLM 生成的有限辅助 QA 集近似该效用，在被评估模型冻结的条件下优化 teacher-forced 答案概率目标，并利用视觉证据的单调性与边际收益递减性质，贪心地构造嵌套子集，提出 QA mini-batch greedy（QA-MBG），每步从随机采样的 QA 分量估计 token 边际增益。实验显示 QA-MBG 比全量贪心更便宜且更有效，单图约需一次前沿 VLM 调用与 0.5 H100 GPU 小时即可得到覆盖保留率至 0.3 的嵌套子集轨迹；在 Qwen3-VL-4B 与 Gemma 4 E4B 上、来自九个基准的 900 张图像上，其在留出 QA 与图像基础长文生成上相对现有剪枝基线仍有明显余量，同时将搜索得到的子集与全 token 推理的差距大幅缩小。
innovations: 提出上限式问题设定：在离线搜索成本可忽略的前提下，为固定预算求解一个共享视觉 token 子集，以支撑整幅图像上的广泛问答分布，从而区分“剪枝固有上限”与“现有选择器能力不足”。
用前沿 VLM 生成有限辅助 QA 集来近似子集效用，并在被评估模型冻结的条件下优化 teacher-forced 答案概率目标，避免训练式选择器带来的模型改动。
提出 QA mini-batch greedy（QA-MBG），利用单调性与边际收益递减构造嵌套子集，每步仅从随机采样的 QA 分量估计 token 边际增益，比全量贪心更省算力也更有效。
给出可复现的成本-效果画像：单图约一次前沿 VLM 调用加 0.5 H100 GPU 小时，产出覆盖最高 0.3 保留率的嵌套子集轨迹，并在 Qwen3-VL-4B、Gemma 4 E4B、九个基准共 900 张图像上量化了相对现有基线的余量与逼近全 token 推理的程度。
papers.scenario_cn: 为视觉 token 剪枝研究提供可参照的性能天花板与离线搜索方案：适用于需要评估自研剪枝方法是否已接近极限、或愿意以一次性离线搜索成本换取更优固定预算子集的多模态推理部署场景。

papers.title: Neuro-Inspired Inhibitory Message Passing for Accurate and Token-Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning
papers.abstract: Multi-agent systems promise to solve problems by bringing together information beyond the reach of any individual agent. Retrieval and tool use can distribute this information across agents, making communication essential to collaboration. A central challenge is keeping crucial evidence visible in each agent's context as messages accumulate. Repeated information can crowd out rare, decisive evidence. Models of cortical circuits suggest a principle for addressing this imbalance: inhibition can selectively suppress shared inputs while preserving sensitivity to weaker signals. We adapt this principle into inhibitory message passing, a training-free communication router that cancels redundant evidence separately for each evidence sentence and receiver. Each round, it forwards evidence sentences restated in agents' messages, delivering each at most once to receivers whose own evidence lacks it and excluding the senders' reasoning and answers. Against standard message passing, accuracy in peer groups rose by 39-77 percentage points across three benchmarks, and tokens per run fell by 10-46%. Gains held across seven open models spanning four to thirty-two billion parameters and two commercial models, in groups up to sixty-four agents, and across multi-agent architectures including peer-to-peer, orchestrator-worker, and multilevel hierarchical organizations. These findings support a scalable design pattern for more accurate and token-efficient multi-agent reasoning.

papers.title_zh: 受神经抑制机制启发的消息传递：实现准确且词元高效的多智能体推理
papers.summary_cn: 多智能体协作中消息不断累积，重复信息会挤占罕见但关键的证据，论文从皮层环路的选择性抑制获得灵感，提出 inhibitory message passing：一种免训练的消息路由器，对每条证据句与每个接收方分别抵消冗余证据。每轮它只转发被 agent 消息复述的证据句，且对自身证据中缺失该句的接收方至多投递一次，并排除发送方的推理过程与最终答案。在三个基准上，相比标准消息传递，同侪组准确率提升 39–77 个百分点，单次运行 token 消耗下降 10–46%；收益在 4B–32B 的七个开源模型、两个商用模型、最多 64 个 agent 的群体，以及点对点、编排者-工作者和多层分级架构中均成立。
innovations: 把皮层环路的抑制机制映射为按证据句、按接收方逐一抵消冗余的通信路由规则，无需任何训练或微调
仅转发被复述的证据句并做去重投递：每条证据对缺少它的接收方至多发送一次，同时剥离发送方的推理与答案以减少污染
在三个基准上取得 39–77 个百分点准确率提升，并把每轮 token 消耗降低 10–46%
在 4B–32B 七个开源模型、两个商用模型、最多 64 agent 群体及点对点/编排者-工作者/多层分级三类拓扑上验证增益可迁移
papers.scenario_cn: 适用于需要多智能体共享检索证据与工具结果的长链路推理系统，如企业知识问答、深度调研与复杂任务编排平台，可在不换模型的前提下同时降低错误率与推理成本。

papers.title: CheckDistill: Adaptive Checklist Distillation for Efficient Distributional Reward Modeling in Image Editing
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning for instruction-guided image editing requires reward models that provide reliable, accurate, and efficient feedback. Direct scalar prediction compresses multidimensional editing preferences, whereas generative evaluators can expose their judgment through explicit reasoning. However, broad scoring criteria do not specify all instance-dependent editing and preservation constraints, and generating long reasoning trajectories is costly for online optimization. We introduce CheckDistill, a pointwise reward modeling framework that internalizes instruction-adaptive checklists. We decompose each editing condition into atomic, independently verifiable requirements and construct four-dimensional scoring labels together with structured verification evidence. After supervised score initialization, a privileged teacher conditions on checklists, item-level judgments, and dimension-level rationales to supervise the student's own scoring trajectories. A reliability-weighted on-policy self-distillation objective adjusts supervision at score tokens according to agreement between the teacher's expected scores and reference labels, while retaining candidate probability weights in a truncated token support. The deployed student directly predicts four score distributions without checklist inputs or explicit reasoning and aggregates their expectations into a scalar reward. CheckDistill achieves aggregate accuracies of 72.30%, 56.67% and 82.90% on MMRB2, MER-Bench and EditReward-Bench, respectively, exceeding the compared open-source baselines on all three metrics.

papers.title_zh: CheckDistill：面向图像编辑高效分布奖励建模的自适应清单蒸馏
papers.summary_cn: 针对指令引导图像编辑的强化学习需要可靠又高效的奖励模型这一问题，论文提出逐点（pointwise）奖励建模框架 CheckDistill，把每条编辑条件拆成原子化、可独立验证的清单式要求（checklist），并配套构造四维评分标签与结构化验证证据。训练时先用监督方式初始化分数，再由能读取清单、逐项判断和维度理由的特权教师去监督学生自己的打分轨迹，采用可靠性加权的 on-policy 自蒸馏目标——按教师期望分与参考标签的一致程度调节 score token 处的监督强度，并在截断的 token 支撑集内保留候选概率权重。部署学生不再需要清单输入或显式推理，直接输出四个分数分布并取其期望聚合为标量奖励，在 MMRB2、MER-Bench、EditReward-Bench 上分别达到 72.30%、56.67%、82.90% 的总体准确率，三个指标均超过所对比的开源基线。
innovations: 提出指令自适应的清单内化机制：把每条编辑指令分解为原子、可独立验证的要求，并据此构造四维评分标签与结构化验证证据，解决“通用评分准则无法覆盖实例相关的编辑与保留约束”的问题。
设计特权教师 + 可靠性加权 on-policy 自蒸馏目标：教师同时条件于清单、逐项判断与维度理由来监督学生的评分轨迹，并按教师期望分与参考标签的一致程度只对 score token 加权，在截断 token 支撑内保留候选概率权重。
部署形态为四维分数分布头，无需清单输入与长链推理即可给出标量奖励，把“多维偏好表达”和“在线优化可承受的开销”统一在一个点式奖励模型里。

papers.title: GeoART: Geometry-Aware Refinement via Test-Time Scaling for Camera-Conditioned Video Diffusion
papers.abstract: Camera-conditioned video diffusion models often suffer from inaccurate camera control and geometric inconsisten- cies because camera constraints and estimated geometry are only weakly enforced during denoising. Existing reme- dies often require costly geometry-aware fine-tuning or ad- ditional 3D supervision. We introduce GeoART, a training- free self-refinement framework that improves camera con- trollability through geometry-aware test-time scaling. At selected denoising steps, GeoART generates multiple can- didates within the Predict-and-Perturb cycle and eval- uates them using a geometry prior, without directly modify- ing the denoising trajectory. A confidence gate suppresses unreliable geometric evidence, while rank-calibrated prob- abilistic selection combines score magnitude and relative rank to choose the next refinement state. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in camera controlla- bility, multi-view consistency, and visual quality over exist- ing sampling and self-refinement methods, without training or modifying the pretrained video diffusion model

papers.title_zh: GeoART：面向相机条件视频扩散的几何感知测试时缩放精炼
papers.summary_cn: 针对相机条件视频扩散模型在去噪过程中对相机约束与估计几何仅做弱约束、导致相机控制不准与多视角几何不一致的问题，作者提出 GeoART——一个无需训练的自精炼框架，通过几何感知的测试时缩放来提升相机可控性。方法在选定的去噪步上运行 Predict-and-Perturb 循环：先生成多个候选样本，再用几何先验对候选打分评估，而不直接修改去噪轨迹；同时引入置信度门控抑制不可靠的几何证据，并用排序校准的概率选择策略把分数绝对值与相对排名结合，决定下一步的精炼状态。实验表明，在不训练、不修改预训练视频扩散模型的前提下，GeoART 在相机可控性、多视角一致性和视觉质量上稳定优于现有采样与自精炼方法。
innovations: 提出训练无关的 GeoART 自精炼框架，把测试时缩放引入相机条件视频扩散，无需几何感知微调或额外 3D 监督
设计 Predict-and-Perturb 循环：在选定去噪步生成多个候选并用几何先验评估，仅调整精炼状态而不直接改写去噪轨迹
引入置信度门控机制过滤不可靠的几何证据，避免错误几何信号污染采样
提出排序校准的概率选择策略，融合分数幅值与相对排名来选择下一精炼状态，在相机可控性、多视角一致性和视觉质量三方面均取得一致提升

papers.title: TriTD: Tri-Partite Trajectory-Distribution Distillation for Real-Time Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion has emerged as a leading paradigm for efficient video generation, yet its practical deployment remains bottlenecked by the trade-off between generation quality and inference efficiency. We attribute this bottleneck to three error sources in AR rollouts: the base model error, the train-inference distribution mismatch, and the upstream error propagation. Building on this decomposition, we derive closed-form upper bounds on the per-step and cumulative errors, providing a principled basis for jointly optimizing generation quality and inference efficiency. Guided by this analysis, we propose TriTD, a Tri-Partite Trajectory-Distribution co-optimized distillation framework with three complementary modules. First, for ODE initialization, we adopt a Next-Node Trajectory Distillation (NTD) objective, which shortens the supervision horizon and admits a lower regression-error floor. Second, we introduce Chunk-Graded Noising (CGN), a monotonically non-decreasing per-chunk noising schedule that helps narrow the expected train-inference noise mismatch and removes redundant KV-cache updates, yielding substantial speedups at no quality cost. Third, we propose Orthogonal-Parallel DMD (OP-DMD), a distribution-matching loss that retains the original DMD supervision while introducing an additional regression constraint in the orthogonal subspace to suppress off-axis drift, improving both training stability and final generation quality. Extensive experiments show that TriTD consistently surpasses existing baselines in visual quality while reaching a real-time throughput of 26.8 FPS on a single H100 GPU, delivering a balanced quality-efficiency solution for interactive streaming video generation.

papers.title: InJePA: Intention-First Latent Planning with Coupled JEPA World Models for Visual Navigation
papers.abstract: Visual navigation requires goal directed planning informed by predictions of environment dynamics. Representative navigation world model methods propose complete action candidates before predicting consequences for selection or search updates. For each candidate, predictions primarily evaluate proposed actions rather than guide its stepwise construction. To this end, we propose InJepa, an intention first planning paradigm centered on latent states. A goal conditioned JEPA proposes latent intentions, and an action conditioned JEPA continually predicts future latent states. Both operate in a shared latent space to align their predictive representations. Within each candidate, predicted consequences feed into the next intention proposal and action inference, forming a closed loop of intention, action, and consequence. This extends the world model's role beyond evaluation to leading candidate construction through latent intentions. We evaluate InJepa through closed loop image goal navigation in Habitat MP3D. The results show effective multistep navigation through intention guided action generation and consequence feedback. Experiments across encoders further support applicability across visual representations. These findings support latent intentions as the central planning object and show that world models can directly guide plan construction through coordinated reasoning about intentions and consequences. papers.title_zh: InJEPA：面向视觉导航的意图优先潜空间规划与耦合 JEPA 世界模型

papers.title: Pretrained Features as Teachers, Not States: Compact Latent World Models for Visual Planning
papers.abstract: A key design choice in visual world models is what information the latent state is encouraged to preserve. Models that learn a latent space with only a latent-prediction objective adapt to environment dynamics, but the predictive objective alone admits collapsed solutions and provides no explicit constraint on the visual information retained by the latent. Models built directly on pretrained visual features inherit a strong visual prior, but tie prediction and planning to a frozen state space. We propose Anchor-WM, which instead uses pretrained visual features as a teacher for learning a compact latent state rather than as the world-model state itself. Anchor-WM learns this compact latent with action-conditioned dynamics, while distilling the dense DINO representations through a training-only distillation head. This encourages the compact latent to retain visual information captured by the pretrained representation while discouraging representational collapse. At inference, the DINO encoder and distillation head are discarded, allowing prediction and planning to operate entirely in the learned latent space. Anchor-WM achieves the best average success rate across the four evaluated environments while enabling substantially faster planning than world models operating directly on DINO patch features. These results show that pretrained visual features can effectively guide world-model learning without defining the state space used for prediction and planning.

papers.title_zh: 预训练特征作为教师而非状态：用于视觉规划的紧凑潜世界模型
papers.summary_cn: 论文针对视觉世界模型中“潜状态该保留什么信息”这一设计问题：仅用潜预测目标学习的潜空间虽能适配环境动力学，却存在表征坍缩风险且对保留的视觉信息没有任何显式约束；而直接以预训练视觉特征（DINO）作为世界模型状态，又会把预测与规划锁死在冻结的特征空间中。作者提出 Anchor-WM，把 DINO 的稠密表征当作“教师”，通过仅在训练时存在的蒸馏头把视觉信息蒸馏进一个带动作条件动力学的紧凑潜状态，从而在避免表征坍缩的同时获得可预测、可规划的紧凑状态；推理阶段丢弃 DINO 编码器与蒸馏头，预测和规划完全在学习到的潜空间内完成。在四个评估环境中 Anchor-WM 取得最高平均成功率，且规划速度显著快于直接在 DINO patch 特征上运行的世界模型。

papers.title: Conditional Average Treatment Effect Distillation for Hypothetical State-Intervention Targeting Under Budget Constraints
papers.abstract: Personalized public-health targeting must capture heterogeneous intervention benefits while remaining interpretable under resource constraints. Flexible causal-effect models can be hard to operationalize, while coarse subgroup policies may lose individualized effect information. We study budget-constrained hypothetical state interventions in observational data without a logged historical decision policy. For obesity, elevated glucose, and lifetime smoking-history states, causal-structure-informed pretreatment covariates are prespecified, with capacity capped at 70% of those observed in the adverse state. We evaluate causal distillation where Causal Forest and Bayesian Causal Forest teachers estimate conditional average treatment effects (CATEs), which decision tree and random forest students approximate. We compare individualized policies with unsupervised K-means subgroup policies and supervised causal-tree policies with leaf counts matched to K-means cluster counts. Observational policies are assessed on held-out data using a doubly robust estimator, bootstrap uncertainty, and decision-focused teacher-student fidelity measures. Across PIMA obesity and glucose and NHANES smoking-history experiments, each distilled student was within 0.011 absolute utility of its teacher, with allocation Jaccard similarities of 0.738-0.937. K-means and causal-tree policies were also competitive, with the highest point-estimate policy varying by application. Prespecified paired comparisons were nonsignificant after Holm adjustment, while near-budget-boundary agreement was less stable than global fidelity for some teacher-student pairs. Findings support causal distillation for translating flexible effect models into simpler budgeted targeting rules, although observational estimates depend on causal-identification assumptions and require longitudinal or prospective validation.

papers.title: LOOP: Recovery-Aligned Iterative Layer Pruning via On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: Layer-level pruning is attractive for large language model (LLM) deployment as it reduces the model size while preserving a dense architecture that can be efficiently executed on standard hardware. Current methods typically follow a one-shot paradigm, which first removes selected layers to reach a target model size and then performs additional training to recover model capabilities. However, pruning directly to the target size can substantially degrade reasoning capabilities, making subsequent recovery more difficult under a limited training budget. Moreover, this paradigm separates layer selection from recovery, limiting the use of recovery information to guide selection and potentially hindering the recovery of reasoning capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose LOOP, a Layer-level Recovery-Oriented On-Policy Pruning framework that interleaves pruning and recovery across multiple shots. In each shot, LOOP removes a single layer and performs short on-policy distillation, mitigating the abrupt degradation in reasoning capabilities associated with one-shot pruning. To guide layer selection in subsequent shots, LOOP reuses on-policy trajectories and optimization signals from recovery to jointly assess each remaining layer's reasoning contribution and recovery sensitivity, thereby making layer selection recovery-aware. Evaluations on several benchmarks show that LOOP consistently outperforms one-shot baselines in average accuracy across different model scales and pruning ratios.

papers.title_zh: LOOP：基于在线策略蒸馏的恢复对齐迭代式层剪枝

papers.title: PDNet: Exploring Pruning and Distillation for Real-Time Worker Activity Recognition in Industrial Assembly
papers.abstract: In this work, we address real-time fine-grained human activity recognition (HAR) in industrial assembly and introduce PDNet, a new framework that jointly exploits structured pruning and knowledge distillation for 3D convolutional networks. We start by training a 3D-CNN backbone in a supervised manner. Then, PDNet applies channel-wise structured pruning to obtain a more compact network. In the third step, our method is optimized using knowledge distillation from the large unpruned teacher to recover accuracy lost due to pruning. On the challenging MECCANO dataset with an X3D-M backbone, the pruned model without distillation reaches a Top-1 accuracy of 25.54 %, while PDNet raises this to 39.46 %, with only 6.90 MB model size and 3.78 GFLOPs. papers.title: Dynamical Batching: How Class-Cycling Training Shapes the Internal Structure of Neural Networks
papers.abstract: We investigate whether cyclically varying the class composition of training batches can modify both the performance and the internal organization of neural networks. Motivated by nonequilibrium systems, in which cycling between related sub-goals can make switching between their solutions increasingly efficient, we introduce Dynamical Batching (DB), a sampling protocol that periodically emphasizes each class while leaving the loss and the optimizer unchanged, and compare it with Uniform Batching (UB), in which every mini-batch has equal class proportions. In the regime where standard training fails, DB changes the outcome: on a three-arm spiral, a capacity-limited MLP that plateaus far below perfect accuracy under UB fits the training data under DB. Tracking individual weights, we find that under DB the change between class-specialized states is carried by a smaller set of weights than under UB, and that this set is markedly more persistent from cycle to cycle, on every synthetic dataset we test and in a wider network that fits the data under both protocols. This organization is a signature of the protocol rather than a predictor of its benefit: it appears equally where DB leaves accuracy unchanged. On CIFAR-10, the same protocol modestly improves the test accuracy of a channel-narrowed ResNet-10, a standard residual architecture, and of a second capacity-limited convolutional network. These results show that how class emphasis is distributed in time can shape both the solution a network reaches and the internal structure of the network.

papers.title: A Fisher-Geometric View of Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: Consolidating specialized foundation models into a unified generalist is a central goal of post-training. Two approaches are in common use: model merging, which is fast but treated as a heuristic, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation, which matches distributions but demands heavy rollout compute and suffers from cross-task gradient conflict. We show that the two are one objective seen at different orders. Within a shared basin of homologous specialists, the multi-teacher on-policy distillation objective is, to second order, exactly the Fisher-merging objective. Its minimizer is therefore the Fisher merge, a classic model-merging method given by a closed-form combination of the specialists, so merging is optimal, to second order, as a closed-form stage of distillation. Building on this identification, we propose Residual-Governed Branch-and-Merge(RGBM), a two-phase consolidation procedure. Concretely, a full-parameter Fisher merge is intractable on foundation models, so Phase~1 restricts the merge to the task-vector subspace. Extending tangent-space analyses of merging, we show that the same coefficients that mix task vectors also mix implicit rewards, which lets a residual program on unlabelled prompts solve for them. The program minimizes the worst per-domain residual and reports its energy-normalized values as the domain residual spectrum. Phase~2 lets this spectrum govern what may be added: RGBM passivates domains with low normalized residuals, trains isolated branches only for domains above the spectral gap, and writes back the admitted updates with calibrated shrinkage. On two open-source consolidation suites, the Phase~1 merge alone matches or outperforms fully trained multi-teacher distillation, and RGBM improves on it further with zero extra joint-training steps, whereas every un-gated write-back, including continued joint distillation from the merge, falls below it.

设计 domain residual spectrum 门控机制——最小化最差 per-domain 残差并做能量归一化，只对越过 spectral gap 的领域训练独立分支、低残差领域直接 passivate，配合 calibrated shrinkage 写回，实现零额外联合训练步的增益。

papers.title: Adding Heavy-Ball Momentum to Distributed Constrained Optimization for Energy Resource Management Subject to Time-Delays and Quantization
papers.abstract: This paper studies a hybrid discrete-time signed gradient-consensus method with heavy-ball momentum, paired communication delays, and fixed logarithmic quantization. The method preserves the aggregate supply-demand equality at every iteration. For a static connected undirected graph and bounded delays, a Lyapunov-Krasovskii analysis establishes practical stability by isolating the discontinuous quantization error as an additive disturbance and closing a computable invariant-sublevel argument. The resulting ergodic residual bound is quadratic in the quantization resolution, and exact convergence to the smooth penalized equality-constrained optimizer is recovered in the unquantized case. For delay-free unquantized quadratic costs, an exact modal analysis identifies the heavy-ball stability region and optimal parameters, with the predicted rate validated on a fixed sparse network. A reproducible delayed experiment reports all constants and a certificate whose guaranteed steady-state level lies below the reported initialization. A separate mixed generator-battery experiment exercises the signed update directly. Finite smooth penalties approximate, but do not generally enforce, the local box constraints exactly.

papers.title: Asynchronous On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract: Unlike on-policy distillation (OPD), which depends on a separate teacher model, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) leverages a single language model acting simultaneously as the student and the teacher, with the teacher conditioned on privileged information. Despite this architectural simplicity, synchronous rollout generation dominates overall training time, creating a severe systems bottleneck when scaling OPSD. To address this, we introduce Asynchronous On-Policy Self-Distillation (AsyncOPSD), a framework that decouples rollout generation from learner updates to improve training throughput. Since the teacher and student share parameters, AsyncOPSD eliminates the multi-model coordination overhead inherent to OPD architectures in asynchronous training. As the student policy evolves, buffered trajectories generated by older policies become stale, potentially degrading performance. To mitigate this, we introduce a distillation objective based on staleness-aware policy control and token-level entropy weighting. Across three model sizes and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, AsyncOPSD improves the training throughput by $1.96$--$2.25\times$ over synchronous OPSD while increasing average benchmark accuracy.

papers.title: Structured Latent Dynamics for Long-Horizon Embodied World Models
papers.abstract: Reliable long-horizon prediction remains a central challenge for embodied world models. Although recent generative models can synthesize visually plausible action-conditioned futures, their latent dynamics are typically learned through unconstrained transition modules, which may gradually deviate from coherent physical evolution as predictions are recursively rolled forward. We investigate whether explicitly structuring latent state evolution can improve the stability and utility of such imagined trajectories. To this end, we introduce HWM, a structured dynamics framework that represents backbone latents in a learned phase space consisting of generalized coordinates and momenta. Future states are propagated through dissipative Hamiltonian dynamics and mapped back to the original latent representation through a learnable inverse interface. The resulting formulation can be integrated into existing world-model architectures without redesigning their perception or decoding components, while multi-step transition supervision encourages the structured rollout to remain aligned with the latent trajectories induced by real observations. Controlled simulation experiments show that HWM produces more accurate estimates of velocity, acceleration, and jerk and substantially reduces long-horizon energy drift relative to unstructured latent dynamics. We further evaluate the approach across three distinct embodied world-model settings, covering single-arm multi-view prediction with Ctrl-World, dual-arm single-view prediction with EVAC, and task-oriented single-arm prediction with Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B. On RoboCasa, incorporating HWM into Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B yields a 2.7% relative improvement in task success. On real-world AgiBot World trajectories, it improves nDTW by 9.7% with Ctrl-World and Logic by 8.4% with EVAC.

Controlled simulation experiments show that HWM produces more accurate estimates of velocity, acceleration, and jerk and substantially reduces long-horizon energy drift relative to unstructured latent dynamics. We further evaluate the approach across three distinct embodied world-model settings, covering single-arm multi-view prediction with Ctrl-World, dual-arm single-view prediction with EVAC, and task-oriented single-arm prediction with Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B. papers.title: Clean Forcing: Drift-Resistant Autoregressive Video Diffusion with a Frozen Base
papers.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models generate streaming video of arbitrary length by conditioning each new chunk of frames on those already generated. However, they suffer from exposure bias, where a model trained on clean context must continue from its own imperfect outputs, and errors compound until quality collapses within seconds (drift). Existing methods either require cluster-scale base retraining, apply training-free inference corrections with inconsistent results, or train frozen-base correctors for sampling and cache errors. We instead find that drift is largely deterministic and therefore learnable, as holding the noisy state fixed while varying only the history reveals a counterfactual velocity gap that is ~95% systematic across noise seeds. Based on this observation, we introduce Clean Forcing, which trains a 5.9M-parameter LoRA corrector on the frozen base model to regress this gap, with a closed-loop stage that adds DAgger-style aggregation and a drift-contraction objective to expose the corrector to its own rollouts. Because the clean histories can be the base model's own single-shot generations, training needs no real videos, and the merged corrector adds no inference cost. In 50 s text-to-video generation, Clean Forcing reduces {\Delta}-drift from +11.3 to +1.65 without real video and to -0.16 with 40 real clips, improving on the best published result of +3.57 with over 150x less data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Clean Forcing outperforms prior methods in aesthetic quality and data efficiency with reduced drift for long-horizon video generation.

papers.title: Dynamics-Aware Sparse Attention for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion
papers.abstract: Autoregressive Diffusion Transformers have emerged as a powerful paradigm for long video generation. However, they are often constrained by prohibitive computational overhead and substantial memory footprints. This inefficiency arises from dense computation mechanisms that allocate uniform processing resources across all spatiotemporal regions, failing to leverage the inherent temporal redundancy of video where motion is typically confined to sparse areas. In this paper, we propose Dynamics-Aware Sparse Attention (DASA), a unified framework that shifts from dense computation to sparse, motion-driven generation to eliminate both storage and computational redundancies. Inspired by video codec principles, our approach explicitly decouples video content into dynamic and static regions. To mitigate memory bottlenecks, we selectively compress the historical KV cache by retaining only dynamic features within the generated chunk. Furthermore, to reduce computational overhead, we employ a region-level computation allocation strategy based on localized dynamics. Additionally, a dynamics-guided distillation method is introduced to enhance performance via a lightweight distillation training process. Experiments on VBench demonstrate that our approach accelerates autoregressive video generation by 2.16x, while preserving high visual fidelity.

papers.title: GeoV2V: Geometry-Grounded Video Diffusion Model for Driving Scene Generation
papers.abstract: Novel view synthesis under trajectory changes is essential for autonomous driving simulation, yet existing methods struggle to generate consistent videos when extrapolating to unseen viewpoints such as lane shifts. Reconstruction-based approaches maintain geometric consistency but degrade in visual quality under large viewpoint changes, while reconstruct-then-restore methods often produce visually plausible frames yet suffer from geometric and temporal inconsistencies. We present GeoV2V, a geometry-grounded video-to-video diffusion framework that synthesizes temporally coherent driving videos along novel trajectories by integrating LiDAR and depth-derived geometric priors with full-video conditioning in the Wan 2.1 backbone. A key challenge in learning cross-lane transformations is the lack of synchronized multi-trajectory supervision in real-world datasets. To address this, we also introduce Para4D, a synthetic dataset capturing synchronized multi-lane driving videos within dynamic scenes, which provides explicit supervision for lane-shift generation and serves as a strong training prior for geometry-consistent view synthesis. Experiments on Waymo, nuScenes, and Para4D demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in visual quality, geometric consistency, and robustness to complex lighting dynamics under large trajectory shifts. Project page: this https URL

papers.title: Holo4D: Holistic 4D Reconstruction as Geometric Control for Video Diffusion
papers.abstract: Synthesizing a monocular video from a new camera trajectory requires preserving the observed scene geometry and motion while completing regions that become newly visible. Feed-forward 4D reconstructors recover the structure of the observed scene, whereas video diffusion models provide a generative prior for completing unseen content. We introduce Holo4D, a video reshooting framework that uses reconstructed 3D trajectories as a holistic source-view 4D scaffold. We project these trajectories into the requested views and encode their geometry and source appearance to guide a pretrained video diffusion model. Together with the source video and target cameras, the scaffold grounds generation in reconstructed observations while leaving unsupported regions to the generative prior. Experiments demonstrate the value of trajectory-based conditioning for camera control and novel-view synthesis. The framework accommodates different 4D reconstructors without retraining the video generator, allowing it to benefit from future advances in source reconstruction. More details can be found in our project page.

papers.title: RAGLeak: Supply-Chain Privacy Backdoors in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enables large language models to access external knowledge during inference, but its reliance on external knowledge bases also introduces new attack surfaces. Existing data extraction attacks against RAG systems rely on either prompt injection, which heavily depends on the generator's instruction-following capability, or backdoors that reproduce or paraphrase retrieved documents but struggle to balance extraction fidelity and stealthiness. In this paper, we propose RAGLeak, a supply-chain privacy backdoor attack that decouples information leakage from direct textual exposure. When triggered, the generator reversibly obfuscates retrieved private documents for high-fidelity recovery by an auxiliary LLM. Across three model families and three application domains, RAGLeak achieves up to $100\%$ ASR with limited impact on benign utility and at most a $10$-percentage-point ASR drop under representative detection-based defenses. The backdoor remains effective after clean fine-tuning and across model scales and versions, revealing an underexplored supply-chain privacy risk in RAG systems. The source code is available at this https URL .

papers.title: StrucChunk: Structure-Aware Retrieval for Legal Document RAG
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) can ground LLM outputs in domain-specific knowledge, but legal documents are hard: standard chunking fragments hierarchical argument structure, and generic embeddings struggle with both precise citation matching and semantic understanding. We propose StrucChunk (Structure Aware Chunking) with hybrid dense-sparse retrieval for hierarchically structured legal documents. It treats documents as directed acyclic graphs of provisions, preserves clause boundaries, resolves cross-references before embedding, and combines BM25 with BGE-M3 via Reciprocal Rank Fusion. We evaluate on five corpora, three legal traditions and two languages. StrucChunk reaches 100% boundary precision (vs. 7.7% for recursive splitting on CrPC), preserves 97.6% of documented cross-references (vs. 0%), and matches section coverage with 40.3% fewer chunks on GDPR. On LegalBench-RAG (6,858 query-passage pairs), it achieves Char-Recall@8 of 48.18% vs. 23.59% for the best baseline (+104%), surpassing the published state of the art by +83%. On 501 queries each for CrPC and CPC (Indian law), Recall@5 improves from 0.557 to 0.804 (+44.4%) and from 0.158 to 0.259 (+64.6%); chunking accounts for 88% and 73% of the gain. On 501 GDPR queries, Recall@5 is 0.868 with R@1 improving +59%. On NitiBench-CCL (3,730 Thai financial law queries), HR@5 is 0.856 vs. 0.594 for naive chunking (+44.1%), showing that section-boundary alignment is the dominant factor across languages, and cross-reference augmentation adds +2.3% on cross-reference queries. We release the implementation, 5,256 evaluation queries across five legal corpora, annotation methodology and chunking quality metrics. Code: this http URL

papers.title: A Unified Intermediate Representation and Execution Architecture for Heterogeneous and Distributed Neural Simulation
papers.abstract: Equation-based neural modeling offers flexibility, but executing models across processors and nodes requires explicit control of order, ownership, and numerical behavior. We present brian2-atlas, a rebuilt execution architecture retaining Brian2's modeling interface and bringing heterogeneous and distributed targets under a common model-to-execution contract. Its unified intermediate representation, AtlasIR, describes typed state, clocks, schedules, effects, events, and random-stream identities, and is checked by an independent Rust validator. Target-specific implementations support Rust CPU execution, CUDA and Apple Metal GPUs, browser WebAssembly, and MPI within declared contracts. In a repeated full-connectome CPU cohort, the best measured Rust configuration reduced simulation-and-recording time by 5.43-fold relative to the best measured Brian2 C++ configuration on the same Linux host. A 298.9-million-synapse model completed on a 16 GB laptop while the compared C++ preparation path exceeded its controlled memory budget. Distributed execution completed 100.5 seconds of model time for 4,129,924 neurons and 24.1 billion recurrent synapses on four nodes and 32 ranks. A five-point synthetic weak-scaling study reached 860 million neurons and 860 billion recurrent connections for 100 ms on 30 hosts and 240 physical worker cores. These establish tested capacity configurations rather than statistical equivalence or a matched speed advantage over NEST. Published-model workflows extend validation to explicit NMDA dynamics and contextual dendritic plasticity, with up to 2.10-fold acceleration in a matched eight-core NMDA cohort. The results characterize semantic, numerical, and resource boundaries rather than universal compatibility or performance superiority.

papers.title: ACTS: Learning Visuo-Tactile World Models from Human Physical Interaction
papers.abstract: Abstract Action-conditioned world models for contact-rich manipulation require data that captures how contact forms, slides, and releases under varying force. Such data are slow to collect through robot teleoperation, which often lacks force feedback and is constrained by gripper geometry. We ask whether these dynamics can instead be learned from human physical interaction and transferred to a robot. We present ACTS, a visuo-tactile world model trained only on human interaction data. Operators manipulate handheld GelSight sensors while we record third-person and wrist video, tactile images, 6-DoF sensor motion, and tactile-derived normal force, yielding React, a 4.9-hour bimanual dataset across three objects. We represent actions at the tactile sensor as motion augmented by force change, providing a shared action space for human collection and robot execution. ACTS jointly predicts future scene, wrist, and tactile observations. On held-out human data, ACTS improves scene-view prediction by 0.7-2.0 dB PSNR over the stronger of two visuo-tactile world models trained from scratch on React. Without fine-tuning, in the robot teleoperation rollouts we inspected, predicted tactile imprints still appear and disappear with recorded contact. Visual transfer is less robust: camera predictions exceed frame copying on PushT, are mixed on Rope, and fall below it on Motherboard, while wrist views can blur or hallucinate structure. These results suggest that contact dynamics transfer more reliably than visual appearance from human to robot.

papers.title: ActTime: Action-Conditioned World Modeling for Time Series
papers.abstract: Time-series models increasingly condition on known future inputs. In controlled systems, some of these inputs are actions that can be changed, compared, and optimized before execution. A model must therefore do more than predict the realized future: it must predict how outcomes change under different actions from the same observed history and support reliable comparison of candidate plans. We introduce ActTime, an action-conditioned world model for time series. Over the observed history, ActTime updates variable-specific latent states through an action-conditioned transition and corrects them using observations. It then rolls the same transition forward under candidate actions to generate future trajectories. Training uses only factual trajectories, without paired alternative-action outcomes or planning supervision. We construct a simulator-grounded evaluation suite across building energy, traffic, greenhouse climate, and inventory management, covering factual prediction, intervention-effect prediction, offline decision making, and closed-loop planning. ActTime ranks first in 12 of 16 domain-task settings. Across eight methods, the mean pairwise model-ranking reversal rate is 17.8% between factual prediction and intervention fidelity, and rises to 28.4% between intervention fidelity and decision ranking. These results show that factual accuracy, intervention fidelity, and decision quality are related but not interchangeable.

papers.title: A Thousand Faces: A Persuasion Benchmark with Experience-Grounded Persuadees Informed by Psychology and Pragmatics
papers.abstract: People can express the same beliefs and desires yet need different reasons to change their minds. What makes an argument relevant depends on how those views arose: experiences shape what a person finds credible, what matters to them, and what could prompt reconsideration. These personal grounds may also be expressed indirectly, through contextual clues in conversation. Benchmarks that specify beliefs and desires without these connections can reward arguments that match a description while overlooking whether they address the person's reasons. We introduce A Thousand Faces (ATF-Persu), with 1,000 personas across 200 topics and nine domains. Drawing on personality and attitude theories and conversational implicature, we construct five personas per factual context, linking experiences to judgments, expression, and grounds for revision. Evaluations show lower persuasion success than three comparison benchmarks under their respective protocols. Complete backgrounds yield broader use of supplied personal grounds and higher persona faithfulness than simplified specifications; blinded reviewers also rate ATF-Persu above CToMPersu on identifiable personal reasons, their influence on responses, and contextual expression. The dataset is publicly available at this https URL .

papers.title: A general mechanism for collective foraging: percolating recruitment cascades coupled to a maximum-entropy
papers.abstract: Foraging recruitment is a contagion: an agent finding a resource triggers a linear-threshold cascade -- the model for rumour and adoption spread on social networks -- embedded in space. Because activation is degree-normalized, the same rule that spreads the cascade also stifles it as neighbourhoods crowd (density-dependent blocking), so the swarm aggregates on a resource, then releases to explore again. The cascade runs on the communication network, but acting on it moves agents in physical space, and that motion rewires the network: network and physical space are one coupled system, and this feedback -- not tuning -- makes the coordination self-limiting. Because recruitment chains along the graph rather than near neighbours alone, whether a discovery stays local or spans the swarm is a matter of percolation, and past a critical connectivity the swarm holds itself in a cascade window -- locally near-critical though globally subcritical, a self-organized, sandpile-like drive-avalanche cycle. Nothing is tuned, yet behaviours foraging biology documents separately emerge together -- recruitment, marginal-value patch-leaving, and Levy search with a switch to local exploitation. These are not coincidences but one least-committal principle: the resource field and the search both follow from maximum entropy -- Levy search matched to the field's sparsity, recruitment to its clustering, so active-matter order and optimal foraging are one system in two domains. The gains are real but conditional: up to 7.6x the harvest of solitary search when resources are sparse and clustered, shrinking to nothing when search is already easy. Percolating cascades yield a large return on minimal communication. And that sparse, clustered field is the generic one -- resources almost inevitably aggregate, and maximum entropy makes it the least-committal one once they do -- so one untuned rule should recur widely.

papers.title_zh: 群体觅食的一般机制：渗流式招募级联与最大熵分布的耦合
papers.summary_cn: 论文把觅食招募视为一种嵌入物理空间的 contagion：个体发现资源后触发线性阈值级联（社交网络中谣言与采纳扩散的经典模型）。由于激活量按度归一化，同一规则在邻域拥挤时会产生密度依赖的阻断，使群体先聚集于资源、随后自动释放去重新探索。级联在通信网络上传播，但执行动作会移动个体、进而改写网络本身，因此网络空间与物理空间构成一个耦合系统，这种反馈而非参数调优使协调自限。招募链沿图结构延伸而非仅限近邻，所以一次发现是停留在局部还是覆盖全群取决于渗流：越过临界连通度后，群体自我维持在「级联窗口」内——局部近临界、全局亚临界，形成类似沙堆模型的自组织驱动—崩塌循环。整套机制无需调参即可同时涌现出觅食生物学中分别记录的招募、边际值离斑（marginal-value patch-leaving）与带局部开发切换的 Lévy 搜索。作者进一步论证二者同源于最大熵这一最不武断的原则：Lévy 搜索匹配资源场的稀疏性、招募匹配其聚集性，因而活性物质序与最优觅食在两种域中是同一系统。收益是条件性的：在资源稀疏且成簇时收获可达单独搜索的 7.6 倍，而在搜索本就容易时增益消失。
innovations: 将线性阈值级联与度归一化激活耦合到物理空间，提出密度依赖阻断机制，使同一规则既能扩散招募又能自动终止招募，无需额外调参
把通信网络与物理空间建成单一反馈耦合系统，证明「网络改写—运动重连」这一反馈而非参数微调是协调自限的根源
用渗流理论刻画发现的传播范围，给出临界连通度与「局部近临界、全局亚临界」级联窗口，类比沙堆模型的自组织驱动—崩塌循环
以最大熵为统一原理同时导出 Lévy 搜索（匹配资源稀疏性）与招募（匹配资源聚集性），并在稀疏成簇资源下量化出最高 7.6 倍的收获增益、在易搜索条件下归零
papers.scenario_cn: 适用于大规模分布式集群的协同搜索与资源采集（无人机/机器人集群、水下或灾区搜索、分布式传感网络的探测任务），为通信极受限条件下如何以极少量通信获得接近最优的群体觅食效率提供设计依据。
